This Gameplay Live Stream brought to you by Deadly Print Studio and their amazing battlefield effects and more https://deadlyprintstudio.com/ Make your battles come to life!  Custom pieces for almost every army.  

===============GAME INFO=============
The first balance patch of 11th edition is here and brought some interesting shake ups!  Nick and Jordan are keen to test it out, and have brought two armies that should prove a fascinating match up!  The Genestealer Cults finally got some much needed clarification of thier army rule, and Space Marines got a whole new detachment.  This should be interesting!
